reasons.persona_fit: Well-targeted to small business operators with a restrained tone and no sales CTA, though it briefly uses first-person singular 'I' instead of Bareni's standard public 'we'.
reasons.clarity: The core thesis is immediately clear, logically sequenced, and explained in plain language without unnecessary jargon.
reasons.actionability: Offers a highly concrete, low-risk diagnostic method (auditing 5–10 recordings) and explicit decision criteria before committing to an AI pilot.
reasons.factual_grounding: Strictly adheres to evidence boundaries without fabricating customer case studies, benchmarks, or proprietary speech-analysis features.
